nodes.title: Dirichlet–Jordan theorem on pointwise convergence of Fourier series

nodes.summary: Let $f \colon \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{C}$ be $2\pi$-periodic and continuously differentiable, and for $n \in \mathbb{Z}$ let $\hat f_n = \frac{1}{2\pi} \int_0^{2\pi} e^{-int} f(t)\,dt$ be the $n$-th Fourier coefficient of $f$ on $[0, 2\pi]$. Then for every $x \in \mathbb{R}$ the symmetric Fourier partial sums $S_N(f)(x) = \sum_{n=-N}^{N} \hat f_n e^{inx}$ converge to $f(x)$ as $N \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Dirichlet's theorem on pointwise convergence of Fourier series

nodes.summary: Let $f \colon \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{C}$ be continuous and $2\pi$-periodic, and write $S_k(f)$ for the $k$-th symmetric Fourier partial sum of $f$. Then the Cesàro means $\sigma_N(f) = (S_0(f) + S_1(f) + \dots + S_N(f)) / (N + 1)$ converge to $f$ uniformly on $\mathbb{R}$ as $N \to \infty$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove

can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.
